description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS (Tacticus Attack Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. A real click (Ork player) on the Nobz in the fight list, All to target + Confirm (the Outriders); the Space Marine player declines the enemy_targets_unit_fight window (REAL click); the fight resolves; enemy_has_fought opens for the Space Marine player; a REAL click on the Assault Intercessors (TACTICUS, within range of obj_center, eligible to fight) spends 1 CP; they have Fights First and must be the next unit Player 2 selects to fight — the fight list offers only them.
